provider_observations.interpretation: The valid outputs were meaning-unstable at the diagnosis/result level but all remained wrong against protected truth: one said no material defect and three identified TEST DEFECT. This is an unstable-wrong case, showing a semantic-instability signal could be useful as an escalation trigger but is not itself correctness evidence.

provider_observations.provider_errors: Four samples exhausted retries with HTTP 503 high-demand/unavailable responses.
provider_observations.interpretation: Insufficient valid samples for any semantic-stability claim. The single valid result was wrong against protected truth; provider availability is operational evidence, not model-quality evidence for the failed samples.

harness_finding.issue: The initial collector incorrectly allowed one valid sample to be labelled stable_single_cluster and collapsed reviews lacking diagnosis.primary_failure_class into NO_PRIMARY_CLASS even when findings/summary carried materially different conclusions.

scientific_interpretation: Pilot 1 provides directional evidence that repeated black-box sampling can expose within-model instability in a known wrong case, but it does not calibrate a review threshold and cannot establish sensitivity/specificity from one case. It simultaneously falsified an unsafe collector implementation, which has been corrected. Semantic stability remains non-authoritative and stable-wrong controls remain mandatory.
next_step: Rerun semantic calibration with the corrected collector, then expand across protected stable-correct, stable-wrong, lexical-equivalent and materially-different cases before selecting any threshold. Compare conditional R2 against always-R2 only after calibration data exist.
limitations: One protected case cannot establish population-level performance.
The diagnosis-class proxy is task-specific and is not a general semantic equivalence classifier.
No production semantic-entropy threshold has been selected.
Gemini had only one valid sample due provider 503 errors.
The sampling models are experimental candidates and are not granted governance authority by this run.
